handoff_instructions: M2-T08 caller matching service, done in one step. Added packages/domain/src/phone.ts (normalizePhoneNumber, exported from packages/domain/src/index.ts) and packages/core/src/services/caller-matching.ts (matchCallerByPhone, exported from packages/core/src/index.ts), plus packages/core/test/caller-matching.test.ts. matchCallerByPhone(ctx, rawPhone) normalizes the phone, requires customer.read+employee.read, queries public.customers/public.employees scoped to ctx.organizationId (RLS for user actors, service for trusted actors), and returns {status:'no_match'} | {status:'matched', entityType, entityId, displayName} | {status:'ambiguous', candidates, opsCase}. Ambiguous matches call the existing createOpsCase with reasonCode 'low_confidence' (which already writes the audit record + business event) instead of guessing. No schema/migration changes; no other files touched. Tests cover match (customer and employee), no-match, ambiguous (opens ops case), and cross-org isolation. pnpm lint/typecheck/test all green. Next: M2-T09 (communication record service) can call matchCallerByPhone to attach participants when persisting a call/message.
